title: For one date, PARALLELPERIOD returns the whole previous month and DATEADD the same day of the previous month
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "Parallel", CALCULATE ( [Sales], PARALLELPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) ), "DateAdd", CALCULATE ( [Sales], DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) ), "ParallelDays", COUNTROWS ( PARALLELPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) ), "DateAddDays", COUNTROWS ( DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 2, 15 ) )

source.quote: For each interval with at least one value in Date[Date] , the function returns the entire interval shifted by the number of specified intervals.
If not all the days of the month are selected, then each day is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a partly selected month moves day by day

source.quote: If the interval is a partial range of month, quarter, or year then any partial months in the result are also filled out to complete the entire interval.

derivation: The selection is 2024-02-15. PARALLELPERIOD returns all of January 2024: 31 days, sales 300. DATEADD returns 2024-01-15 only: 1 day, sales 100.
